items.description: One prospective read-only preflight authorization covering the complete frozen observation set, target, bundle contract, limits, UTC window, stop/retention policy, and the disclosed pilot role collapse.
items.resolution_rule: One authorization may cover all listed read-only observations; it must not authorize mutation, calibration, measurement, pilot runs, or Stage 18 access.

items.description: Fresh read-only stand preflight and runtime/tool identity output obtained under S17-EXT-001, including the explicit qualification archive integration check.
items.owner: pilot owner acting as operator and custodian
items.resolution_rule: The capture is one-shot and fail-closed; incomplete evidence is retained but cannot advance the state.

items.description: Single-owner pilot preflight acceptance record that independently recomputes all hashes and explicitly disclaims independent audit.
items.resolution_rule: The same owner may review, but the record must say distinct_auditor=false and independent_review_claimed=false.

items.description: Dynamic stand qualification for selected CPU pairs, monotonic clock, atomic/layout behavior, affinity, migration, NUMA residency, page state, storage, and recovery.
items.resolution_rule: Every requested value must have separate verified readback; a development-host or static inventory result is insufficient.

items.description: Exact privileged-control authorization and evidence for H0/H1, frequency/turbo/C-state/SMT observations, prefetch MSR mapping, independent readback, probes, and restoration.
items.owner: platform owner acting under a separately bounded privileged authority
items.resolution_rule: Command success never substitutes for verified state; failure to restore quarantines the stand.

items.description: Clean exact Stage 17 pilot runner release and pilot-candidate bundle identity after this successor is committed and rebuilt.
items.resolution_rule: Dirty or hash-drifted outputs are ineligible; the no-authority bundle by itself grants no run authority.

items.description: Treatment-blind calibration inputs and immutable outputs required before the selected pilot phase, including distance, service-rate, and strict-zero-loss feasibility dependencies where applicable.
required_evidence: D2 calibration plan and accepted d2 per context
items.resolution_rule: No value may be inferred from confirmatory outcomes or replaced by a repository default; cap collapse or invalid calibration blocks advancement.

items.description: Exact pilot run plan and immutable scientific inputs.
items.owner: protocol, statistical, calibration, and controller owner
items.resolution_rule: The plan is prospective, outcome-independent, and contains no confirmatory namespace or outcome access.

items.description: Pilot raw-buffer and durable-storage budget plus two-domain custody, append-only transfer, partial-failure, and recovery evidence.
items.resolution_rule: Capacity must cover the exact pilot plan; overflow or missing custody is a fail-closed blocker.

items.description: One exact phase-scoped Stage 17 pilot authorization binding every accepted predecessor and the finite permitted run set.
required_evidence: all predecessor artifact IDs and SHA-256 values
items.owner: pilot owner acting in the explicitly collapsed pilot roles
items.resolution_rule: Authorization is valid only after S17-EXT-001 through S17-EXT-009 resolve and cannot authorize Stage 18, top-up, cell repair, hidden retry, or outcome access.
